body: FIX proxy_pretrain.sh duckdb-PATH: its snapshot subprocess (finetype profile, which shells duckdb post-0100) failed 'could not invoke duckdb CLI' because background/proxy job PATH lacked duckdb. Worked around via ~/.local/bin/duckdb symlink, but proxy_pretrain.sh (and snapshot_sense_distribution.py) should ensure duckdb on PATH defensively (e.g. prepend ~/.duckdb/cli/* or HOMEBREW bin) so the gate can't silently produce empty snapshots. Also snapshot now profiles parquet directly (committed) — verify proxy_pretrain end-to-end once duckdb is stable.
